OSM way 961236748 is named 中国电信股份有限公司京津冀大数据产业园分公司 and lies immediately south of mapped 汇旺路. This is a reviewed same-operator/same-locality/named-property triangulation, not an explicit source alias declaration, cadastral match or exact address geocode. The 道/路 road-label difference is retained. The much larger Gaocun park is not used as geometry.
